text: ほんば　きょうと　では　だいもんじ　とか　おくりび　と　よんで　いるのだ！
note: Okuribi ("sending-off fire") is the fire lit at the end of the Obon festival to see the spirits of ancestors back to the other world; the Kyoto bonfires are formally called Gozan no Okuribi. The English game has none of this and gives battle advice instead.
claim: The Kyoto mountain bonfires of August 16 are formally called Gozan no Okuribi and send off ancestors' spirits at the end of Obon.

check.quote: It signifies the moment when the spirits of deceased family members, who are said to visit this world during Obon, are believed to be returning to the spirit world
